chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Isma'il ibn Abd al-Khaliq, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Abi Talhah, uncle of Sahl ibn Abd Rabbih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I recited in the Fajr prayer 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' and 'Qul Ya Ayyuha al-Kafirun', and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had done that.

key_terms.صَلَا اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What Surahs did the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) recite in the Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) confirms the Sunnah of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas and Al-Kafirun in the Fajr prayer, a practice directly traced to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). This narration, found in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the continuity of prophetic ritual and the specific emphasis on these two chapters for their thematic completeness in daily worship.
